name: Memphis
brief: An important city in ancient Egypt
short: Memphis, an ancient Egyptian city mentioned in prophecies of judgment against Egypt (<ref="Isaiah 19:13; Jeremiah 2:16; 44:1; 46:14, 19; Ezk.30.13, 16; Hosea 9:6">Isaiah 19:13; Jeremiah 2:16; 44:1; 46:14, 19; Ezk.30.13, 16; Hosea 9:6</ref>).
